_help: Story Corner data. Each story has: id (small letters, no spaces), group (the heading it is listed under), title, picture (emoji), sentences (short sentences), and questions. A 'choice' question has options (text + picture) and answer = the number of the right option, counting from 0. A 'yesno' question has answer true (yes) or false (no). 'explain' is said after a right answer.

stories.title: Writing a Paragraph
sentences: Today our teacher explains how to write a paragraph.

stories.title: Grammar Class
sentences: In grammar class, we study verbs.
Some verbs are irregular verbs, like go and went.
First, we write a statement, like 'I like jogging.'
Then we change it to a negative: 'I don't like jogging.'
Jogging is a gerund, and friendly is an adjective.
Our teacher says, 'Learning depends on practice, so find a way to practice every day.'

questions.question: Which one is an irregular verb?
questions.explain: Go changes to went, so it is irregular.

questions.question: Which sentence is negative?
questions.explain: I don't like jogging is negative.

questions.question: Is jogging a gerund?
questions.explain: Yes. Jogging is a gerund.
